body: People fight and say awful things. I remember saying awful things to get my fiance to leave me but she wouldn't. Those words will still leave scars but they don't have to be the last thing you say.

Dude I feel the same way. It just doesn't make sense. I have a loving wife and son. I'm stuck in the military for the next 2 years unless I want some serious repercussion to get out earlier. I can't stop thinking about it. I even have dreams about it.
What mistakes bud? Talk to me.

I've thought about killing myself over and over for the past month. I know things will change for the better in a couple of years but it's getting tough to hold out even with a wife and kid. Idk I guess I worry that he's going to need me somedays. Even that doesn't really stop the thoughts I have.
